question: Hiromi Kawakami's speculative fiction novel, shortlisted for the 2025 International Booker Prize, is titled:

options.text: Under the Eye of the Big Bird

solution:
The correct answer is __**Under the Eye of the Big Bird**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Hiromi Kawakami** is a celebrated Japanese author renowned for her contributions to speculative fiction and literary works.
 
• **Under the Eye of the Big Bird** is her latest novel that explores themes of surrealism and human connection.
 
• The novel was **shortlisted for the 2025 International Booker Prize**, showcasing its global recognition and literary merit.
 
• Hiromi Kawakami's works often depict everyday life blended with fantastical elements, resonating deeply with readers worldwide.
 
• The International Booker Prize celebrates works translated into English, emphasizing the importance of global literary contributions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hiromi Kawakami's notable works:**

 
 
• **The Nakano Thrift Shop:** A novel exploring human relationships through interactions in a quirky thrift shop.
 
• **Strange Weather in Tokyo:** A poignant story about companionship and love between a woman and her former teacher.
 
• **The Ten Loves of Nishino:** A narrative centered around the romantic escapades of a mysterious protagonist.
 
 
 
• **International Booker Prize:**
 
 
• An annual award recognizing the finest translated works of fiction from around the globe.
 
• It highlights the contribution of translators alongside authors, emphasizing the collaborative effort in bringing stories to a wider audience.
 
 
 
• **Speculative Fiction:**
 
 
• A genre encompassing imaginative and futuristic elements, often blending reality with fantasy.
 
• Hiromi Kawakami's works are known for incorporating speculative fiction to explore profound themes.
 
 
 
• **Literary Themes:**
 
 
• Hiromi Kawakami frequently delves into themes of solitude, human connection, and the surreal.
 
• Her unique storytelling style appeals to readers seeking depth and nuance in contemporary fiction.
